(Original) A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is a contact sensor that generates a signal in response to the force influencing the first battery cell.

(Original) The battery assembly of claim 11 further comprising: a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell and is configured to detect an influence on the second battery cell.

(Original) The battery assembly of claim 17 further comprising: a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell; a third battery cell stacked on top of the second battery cell; and a second sensor positioned between the third battery cell and the second battery cell for detecting at least one force influencing the third battery cell, wherein said first sensor and said second sensor comprise a contact sensor technology. 

(Original) The battery assembly of claim 25, wherein the first sensor further comprises a pressure-sensitive ink configured to detect at least one force influencing the first battery cell.
